6.
(1) It shall be lawful for the Corporation from time to
time,  at  any  general  meeting  of  the  Corporation  and  by  a
majority of not less than two thirds of the members present
and  voting,  to  make  rules  not  inconsistent  with  the
provisions of this Act or any other written law on all or any
of the following matters :—

(a)
the classification of membership and the admission,
withdrawal or expulsion of members;

(b)
the election of office-bearers, the resignation from
or vaction of, or removal from office of, office bearers
and their powers and duties;

(c)
the election of  members of the committee and its
powers conduct and duties;

(d)
the  powers,  duties  and  functions  of  the  various
officers, agents and servants of the Corporation;

(e)
the  procedure  to  be  observed  or  the  summoning
and  holding  of  meetings  of  the  Corporation  and
the Committee, the time, places, notices and agenda
of such meetings and the quorum therefor and the
conduct of business thereat; and

(f)
the administration and management of the property
of the Corporation and the costody of its funds.
